reasons: Position is deep in the safe zone: LTV 0.3838 is well below the corridor act level 0.7 and the 0.86 liquidation LTV, with a 55.38% price drop needed to liquidation.

The only fired screen on this market is ETH/USD staleness by 1 s over max_age (1201 s vs 1200 s) - a marginal heartbeat pause that hits the live and backup oracle instances alike (both read Chainlink ETH/USD), indicating an upstream feed timing artifact rather than a defect in this market's oracle.
Market conditions are healthy: utilization 0.5946 is far below the 0.95 screen threshold, borrow APR is 0.58%, and the pool sits within 0.09% of the oracle price.

Text feeds corroborate no present danger: the venue-status feed reports all testnet markets operating normally with no open oracle or pool incidents, and the Base status feed shows only a scheduled Denim upgrade on Nov 5 18:00-20:00 UTC expected to keep mainnet operational - a watch item for the next cycle, not a current risk.

No action is warranted: selling collateral would spend the sell budget with no risk to offset, and migration targets are no safer (backup shares the same stale feed; demo runs on a team-set mock oracle with no feeds).

judge.applies: the judgment, on the market it names only, through the agreement rule

feeds.title: cmdk testnet venue status (demo feed)
feeds.notice: Published by the cmdk team for the testnet demo; not a real venue. These items describe our own test markets on Base Sepolia and are never part of a production allowlist.

items.title: Testnet markets operating normally
items.text: Testnet markets operating normally | The live, backup and demo markets on Base Sepolia (deployments/testnet.json) accept supply and borrowing. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed
items.text: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed | On 4 November the team's lender supply returned to the live and backup markets (13 USDC each) and the demo market (5,000 dUSDC) on Base Sepolia, and the executor moved to 0xA9bbabE6d75C5BA96CA095586284774c9D09D18b (deployments/testnet.json). All three markets accept supply and borrowing; the live market's public Uniswap 0.01% pool again holds the team's price band. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.
